versions.changelog:
- Improved hallucination safety in resume optimization: quantitative placeholders are now clearly quoted and no longer impact scoring.
- Enhanced verb handling: scores avoid penalizing standard strong verbs ("负责/参与/协助"), and default optimizations upgrade weak verbs and remove filler words.
- Optimization fairness: meta information is stripped before scoring to ensure optimized resumes are assessed on content only.
- Added closed-loop review: optimized resumes are auto-checked for scoring consistency with automated alerts for abnormal drops.
- Minor documentation and clarity improvements throughout SKILL.md.
- Removed unused skill-card.md file.

Version 2.0.0 is a major update with rule-driven, traceable resume scoring, hallucination-safe optimization, and JD-based mock interview question generation for campus/intern PM roles.

- New: Rule-based resume scoring system across 5 key PM competencies with scoring traceability.
- New: One-click, hallucination-safe resume optimization—does not invent info, changes are fully logged and validated.
- New: Generates mock interview questions in 7 categories, tailored to candidate weaknesses and JD, with JD-specific AI section support.
- Enhanced: Accepts resume images, PDFs (uses Tencent Cloud OCR), or plain text as input.
- Outputs detailed, unified diagnostic reports for quick preview, optimization, and interview prep.
- No large model (LLM) required; config files allow customizable scoring standards.
